evidence: Library shows 6 template cards, each with author (e.g. Sarah Chen) and description text.
Card "Professional Resume": title, badges Resume/Business (category/scenario), author Sarah Chen, 1,250 uses, Updated 2024-12-01, description.
Clicking Use Template opened dialog "Professional Resume" with details (category, scenario, author, uses) and a Fill Template form.
With empty form: banner "Required fields missing — Please fill in: Full Name, Job Title, Email, ... Skills"; Preview Result tab is [disabled].
All 14 fields of Professional Resume (12 required + Phone, End Date) accepted typed values; DOM read confirms each value stored.
After filling required fields, Preview Result tab enabled and rendered resume with substituted values (Jane Doe, Tech Corp, MIT, 2018).
Preview tab stayed [disabled] while Email+Skills blank ("Please fill in: Email, Skills"); enabled only after all required non-blank.

issue: Declared email-format field does not validate value
actual: Email input (type=email) accepted "not-an-email": no error, no aria-invalid, Preview tab became enabled and preview rendered "Software Engineer | not-an-email | +1 234 567 8900".

evidence: Resume (Markdown) preview: h1 Jane Doe, h2 sections, h3 "Tech Corp — Senior Developer", strong/emphasis, horizontal separator; no leftover {{placeholders}}.
Copy to Clipboard wrote raw Markdown ("# Jane Doe\n\n**Software Engineer**...") matching template's markdown format; toast "Copied to clipboard!" displayed.

issue: Markdown-structural characters (#, *) not rejected or escaped
actual: Field validation only blocks < > { } [ ] \ | `. Entering "## Injected Heading and **bold**" in Professional Summary was accepted, preview stayed enabled, and the preview rendered an injected H2 element plus STRONG — generated Markdown structure altered by user input.

evidence: Category=Resume → "Showing 1 of 6" (Professional Resume); Scenario=Academic → 1 result; sorts: Most Popular (1250→340 uses), Recently Updated (2024-12-05→2024-09-30), Oldest First (createdAt asc: Email 01-08 first), Alphabetical (A→W).
Typing "me" showed live suggestion list (Professional Resume, Full Name, Company Name...); clicking "Professional Resume" set search input to that text and narrowed library to "Showing 1 of 6".

issue: Search has no typo tolerance / fuzzy matching
actual: Query "resme" (typo of "resume") → "Showing 0 of 6 templates", "No templates found", no suggestions. Query "meting" (typo of "meeting") → same 0 results with no suggestion of "Meeting Minutes".

evidence: Heart buttons favorited Professional Resume + Meeting Minutes (localStorage ["1","3"]); Favorites header button toggles favorites-only view showing exactly those 2.
After favoriting, card icons gained class "fill-current" and header badge showed "Favorites 2" immediately; favorites list contains the two templates.
In favorites-only view: search "meeting" → 1 result (Meeting Minutes); category filter Resume → 1 result (Professional Resume); non-favorited templates never appear.
Search, category/scenario filters, sort selection and favorites-only toggle all changed card list and "Showing X of 6" count in-place; URL stayed http://localhost:6089/ with no page reload.
After submitting custom template, library immediately showed "Showing 7 of 7 templates" including "QA Markdown Template" with no page reload (URL unchanged).
Submit blocked (dialog stayed open, library stayed at 6) when: all fields empty; title/description whitespace-only; and when title/description/author/content valid but zero fields defined.

issue: No placeholder/field consistency validation on custom template submission
actual: Submitted a template whose content uses {{heading}} and {{who}} while the only declared field was "Nonexistent" ({{nonexistent}}). Submission succeeded (library 6→7) and the generated preview shows unresolved placeholders: "{{heading}} / Hello {{who}}, / Regards."

issue: Duplicate field labels neither rejected nor disambiguated; fields not independently fillable
actual: Adding two fields both labeled "Subject" was accepted (both mapped to {{subject}}) and the template submitted. In the fill form both inputs share id "subject": typing "First Subject Value" into one instantly set the same value in the other; console also logged errors.

evidence: Submitted "QA Plain Text Note" (author Tim Tester, description, category Other, scenario Personal, plain-text content, fields Recipient/Subject/Sender); stored in library and count rose to "Showing 8 of 8".
Custom templates "QA Markdown Template" and "QA Plain Text Note" appear as cards, open via Use Template, accept field values and generate previews.

Plain-text custom template previews in a <pre> (white-space: pre-wrap) preserving indentation/newlines: "Note for Alice Johnson

Subject: First Subject Value
    Indented detail line...". Markdown built-in template renders h1/h2/h3, strong, em, hr after substitution.

After reloading http://localhost:6089/: 8 templates including both custom ones (QA Plain Text Note, QA Markdown Template) and header still shows "Favorites 2" with Professional Resume + Meeting Minutes hearts filled.
